plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the seventh season of , Pokémon: Advanced Challenge, in and ( ).

==Single releases==
The Advanced Challenge single DVD releases were released by VIZ Media in 2005 and 2006, containing the entire season between them. Each volume contains five episodes each with the exception of volumes 9 and 10, which contain six episodes each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon: Advanced Challenge - The Complete Collection was released on December 5, 2017 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000074584. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.

 

==Trivia==
 
On retail websites, the stock image of Volume 7 shows the title "Six Pack Attack" (missing the "A"), while physical copies have the title "A Six Pack Attack."
